title: Add a global event handler for beforeinput

labels.name: impacts documentation
labels.description: Used by documentation communities, such as MDN, to track changes that impact documentation

body:
Also imported the input event from the UI events specifications, since that one defines it.

Fixed #4526

(This PR is directly pulled from https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/4530, which can't land due to IP issues.)
